name: io.github.embeddedci-com/embeddedci-mcp
title: EmbeddedCI BenchPod
description: Drive a BenchPod hardware-in-the-loop bench: power, flash, UART, I2C, CAN, analog and logic.

packageArguments.name: --connection
packageArguments.description: Default BenchPod connection: host[:port], a serial device path, 'usb', or 'embeddedci:<device>'.

packageArguments.name: --la-voltage
packageArguments.description: LA I/O voltage (1.8 or 3.3) applied when connecting.

environmentVariables.name: BENCHPOD_CONNECTION
environmentVariables.description: Default BenchPod connection when neither --connection nor the connect tool gives one.

environmentVariables.name: BENCHPOD_LA_VOLTAGE
environmentVariables.description: LA I/O voltage (1.8 or 3.3) applied when connecting.

environmentVariables.name: BENCHPOD_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: embeddedci API key: reach cloud pods (embeddedci:<device>) and the waveform library.
